fact: A GIZ and Ghana Health Service mapping dated December 2023 names GHS-PPMED as owner and GHS as implementer of DHIMS2, lists USAID, the Global Fund, the World Bank, JICA and KOICA as its partners, and states that the servers hosting DHIMS2 and E-Tracker were paid for by donor-funded projects that have ended, leaving the annual server costs unfunded.
title: Ghana Health Data Ecosystem Mapping: Scaling the Use of Digital tools for Vaccination Planning, Deployment and Monitoring
publisher: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
